# Dr. Neema Bhat: Hematologist, Pediatric Oncologist and Bone Marrow Transplant Specialist in Bangalore

> Dr. Neema Bhat is a US-trained Haemato-Oncologist in Bangalore, India, with more than ten years of experience treating blood disorders and blood cancers in children and adults, including bone marrow (stem cell) transplantation. MD (USA) and Fellowship (FAAP) in Pediatric Hematology, Oncology and Bone Marrow Transplantation, Penn State Health, USA.

- OPD: Apollo Hospitals, Bannerghatta Road, Bangalore (Monday to Saturday, 11 AM to 4 PM)
- Evenings: Therapy Clinic (Monday to Saturday, 5 to 7 PM)
- Fridays: Apollo One and Apollo Cradle, Hosa Road, Electronic City (2 to 4 PM)
- Appointments: call or WhatsApp +91 78997 56677

## Treatments

- [Hematology Treatment](https://drneemabhat.com/hematology-treatment): Anemia, bleeding and clotting problems, abnormal blood counts and blood cancers, finding the exact cause.
- [Anemia Treatment](https://drneemabhat.com/anemia-treatment): Iron-deficiency, nutritional and inherited anemias, finding the cause, not just treating the count.
- [Thalassemia Treatment](https://drneemabhat.com/thalassemia-treatment): Transfusion and chelation care, carrier testing and curative bone marrow transplant.
- [Leukemia Treatment](https://drneemabhat.com/leukemia-treatment): Acute and chronic leukemias, with chemotherapy, targeted therapy and transplant planning.
- [Lymphoma Treatment](https://drneemabhat.com/lymphoma-treatment): Hodgkin and non-Hodgkin lymphoma, accurate subtyping and treatment matched to each type.
- [Multiple Myeloma Treatment](https://drneemabhat.com/multiple-myeloma-treatment): Plasma cell cancer care: staging, drug therapy, transplant and protection for bones and kidneys.
- [Pediatric Oncology](https://drneemabhat.com/pediatric-oncology-treatment): Childhood leukemia, lymphoma, solid tumours and blood disorders, with child-friendly care.
- [Brain Tumor Treatment](https://drneemabhat.com/brain-tumor-treatment): Brain and spinal tumours, with surgery, radiation and chemotherapy planned together.
- [Bone Marrow Transplant](https://drneemabhat.com/bone-marrow-transplant): Autologous and allogeneic transplants for children and adults, from donor matching to follow-up.
